thread:
maya_support: Customer tickets says free-trial credits never appeared after signup. acct acct_01H2X, email alice+promo42@maildrop.cc, used referral/promo link REF-A8 at signup 2024-11-05T15:40Z. Email verified, card added, region US. Customer expects 200 credits. Ticket #123456.
jess_payments: thanks — can you paste the signup events (events.log) and pm token type? also is this autogrant or promo? :eyes:
maya_support: autogrant expected (referral + promo combo). events snippet:
```
2024-11-05T15:40:01Z signup.start acct=acct_01H2X method=signup_link ref=REF-A8 ip=3.120.45.2
2024-11-05T15:40:07Z email.verify acct=acct_01H2X email=alice+promo42@maildrop.cc
2024-11-05T15:40:20Z payment.add acct=acct_01H2X method=card brand=visa bin=411111
2024-11-05T15:40:25Z referral.attach acct=acct_01H2X source=legacy-referrals-migration
2024-11-05T15:40:30Z trial.autogrant.skipped acct=acct_01H2X reason=referral_flag
```
jess_payments: the skip reason is interesting — `referral_flag`. we usually skip when referred_by is set and flagged as business/referral partner. is `legacy-referrals-migration` a known source? :thinking:
ryan_platform: yeah — we rolled a migration that backfilled `referred_by` for old invite rows. bug: we set a non-null flag which autogrant logic treats as "partner-referred" and blocks welcome credit. new logic should only block if partner_type=="paid_partner". legacy backfill left partner_type empty but `referred_by` truthy so it hit the skip branch.
jess_payments: ok makes sense. can we do a manual grant now and then patch logic? I can run internal grant CLI.
maya_support: pls do — customer is waiting.
jess_payments: running grant...
```
$ infra-cli grants grant_free_trial --account acct_01H2X --amount 200 --reason "manual: legacy-referral-flagged"
Grant request: submitted
Grant status: OK
grant_id: g_8912
applied: 200 credits
expires: 30d
```
jess_payments: done — customer credits applied :white_check_mark:. Also added case note: "manual grant due to legacy referral migration creating false referral_flag".
ryan_platform: I'll open a bug and a small fix. plan: change autogrant check to ignore backfill-only referrals (partner_type == null) and add a migration safety flag. assigning to me. GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/6577
deploy-bot: deploy queued for platform.patch/6577, will run canary tomorrow morning.
maya_support: great. I'll reply to customer and close ticket after confirmation they see credits. thx @jess_payments @ryan_platform :thumbsup:
jess_payments: np — added audit log entry g_8912 and forwarded to billing for visibility.
ryan_platform: leaving a note to add unit test for the referral check so this doesn't regress.
maya_support: closing thread once customer confirms. last update logged at 2024-11-05T15:48:10Z :lock_with_key:
